payload.title: verify:generated regenerates stale doc/README files outside the drift gate
payload.description: Running pnpm verify:generated on main regenerates 7 doc/README files that are stale vs their generators but are NOT in the drift-check set (verify:generated exits 0): README.md, packages/core/README.md, docs/onboarding.md, docs/cross-platform-client-contract.md, docs/push-adapters.md, docs/status.md, packages/agent-kit/skills/frick-push-notifications/SKILL.md. Committed versions misdescribe current capabilities (e.g. push-adapters.md says Web Push isn't exported; core/README omits openIndexedDBFrickCache + session-scope compatibility). Fix: regenerate+commit these and/or add them to the verify:generated gate so CI catches staleness. Surfaced during the FR-21/43/72/94 merge.
